title: Improve quantized kernels: INT8/FP8 paths, smoothquant preconditioning, and dequant-matmul fusion
author: Leila Martinez
description: Motivation: Quantized inference throughput and latency for production workloads were being impacted by separate dequantize + matmul kernels, missing FP8 fast paths, and the lack of a fused smoothquant preconditioning path. This PR implements fused dequant+matmul kernels for INT8 and FP8 flows, adds an FP8 execution path with careful saturation and round-to-nearest handling, and integrates a fused smoothquant preconditioning step that runs on the device to avoid host-device round trips. Goals: 1) reduce kernel launch overhead and memory traffic, 2) expose FP8 performance where hardware supports it with safe fallbacks, 3) keep KV cache compatibility and continuous-batching scheduling unchanged from an API perspective. Changes: - Add fused dequantize+matmul CUDA kernels (int8 and fp8 variants) with shared-memory tiling and vectorized loads. - Implement FP8 packing/unpacking helpers with explicit exponent/bias handling and exhaustive unit tests. - Add smoothquant fused preconditioning kernel that applies channel-wise scaling before the fused matmul; supports per-layer learned scale factors and runtime toggles. - Introduce a kernel selection heuristic in the runtime: prefer fused kernels when sequence length < 1024 and batch size >= 8, fall back to legacy paths when memory is constrained or when K/V cache uses pinned-format. - Maintain KV cache compatibility: added conversion helpers to keep cached keys in quantized-packed form and avoid full dequant round-trip during generation. - Adjust continuous-batching scheduler to prefer batching quantized requests with similar dtype/profile to improve kernel occupancy (scheduler heuristic + small metrics augmentation). - Extended perf harness and microbenchmarks; add regression tests for correctness against fp32 reference. Checklist: * [x] Unit tests for fp8/int8 kernels * [x] Regression tests for generation with KV cache * [x] Updated kernel selection heuristic and coverage * [x] Benchmark numbers included * [x] Docs note in kernel-optimization.md (short blurb)
